steps: Choose a package or tell us your idea on WhatsApp or our form.
We confirm your styling, add-ons and delivery fee.
Pay a 70% deposit by EFT — the balance is due a week before.
Our team styles your venue on the day, then collects afterwards.
faqs: What is included in an event package?

Every package includes the décor and hire items listed on the card, styling, and setup on the day by our team. Delivery and collection are charged separately — usually around R1,600 for most Gauteng venues — and confirmed upfront in your quote.
How much is delivery and collection?

Delivery and collection is usually around R1,600 for most Gauteng venues. The exact amount depends on your venue's distance from Midrand and the size of the setup, and we confirm it in your quote before you book.
How do I secure my date?
A 70% deposit secures your date, and the balance is due a week before your event. We accept payment by EFT.
Can I customise a package to add or remove items?
Absolutely — every package is a starting point. Add extras like marquee letters, a champagne wall or more balloons, or swap items to suit your theme, and we'll tailor your quote.
Is there a security deposit?
Some items may require a refundable security deposit, but we waive it for many bookings. We'll always tell you upfront if it applies.
What if I need to cancel or reschedule?
With enough notice, your deposit can be refunded or moved to a new available date. Please contact us as early as possible so we can help.
How do I know which package suits my guest count?
Each package shows a guest guide. If you're between sizes, use the 'Help me choose' tool above or WhatsApp us — we can scale any package up or down.
What areas do you cover?
We style events across Midrand, Waterfall, Carlswald, Kyalami, Fourways, Sandton, Centurion and Johannesburg. For venues further out, enquire and we'll confirm whether we can accommodate you.

steps: Pick a package or ask us for a custom hamper.
Add your message, colours or company branding.
Full payment by EFT (including delivery, if applicable).
Ready in 3–5 business days — bouquets same day before 12:00.
faqs: Can I fully customise the contents of a gift hamper?

Yes — all our hampers are completely customisable. Tell us the recipient, the occasion, your budget and any preferences (dietary requirements, favourite brands, colours) and we'll curate something unique.
How much is delivery?
Delivery is free in Midrand, Waterfall, Carlswald, Kyalami and Fourways. Anywhere else in Gauteng is a R150 flat rate. Collection from Midrand is also available.
How do I pay?
Full payment by EFT confirms your order, including the delivery fee where applicable.
What is the lead time for a gift order?
Standard orders take 3–5 business days. Larger or highly customised orders may need 7–10 business days. Flower bouquets can be delivered the same day when ordered before 12:00.
Are the flowers fresh?
Yes — every bouquet is made with fresh flowers. Order before 12:00 for same-day delivery.
Do you do corporate gifting?
Yes — there's no minimum order, bulk-order discounts are available, and we can add your logo to packaging, ribbon and cards. Use the corporate form on this page or WhatsApp us your quantities.
Can I add a personalised message?
Yes — every gift includes a personalised message card at no extra charge.
